Why are my campaigns showing as "Paused"?

When campaigns reach a spend threshold, they show as "Paused" until outstanding charges are paid. With automatic billing and a valid payment method, your campaigns are not likely to hit the pause threshold. If your campaigns are paused, pay your outstanding charges to resume them.
